suggestions.title: Keep one surface, archive the rest
suggestions.problem: Four generated dashboards publish different counts for the same questions.
suggestions.options: A) keep /audit/ and redirect root, /plan/, /docs/, /verified/, /pages/ · B) keep root and archive /audit/ · C) leave all four and add a banner to each
suggestions.trade_off: A is clearest for a reader and the most work; C is free and keeps the confusion.
suggestions.needs_decision: Yes - this is a product decision, not a data one.

suggestions.title: Read the remaining 25 structure sheets
suggestions.problem: 46 of 94 rows have no fee, stack or late-registration close.
suggestions.options: A) transcribe all 25 · B) transcribe only the 14 one-day events · C) leave them blank
suggestions.trade_off: Each sheet is one document and about ten numbers; the only cost is time.

suggestions.title: Add a targeted, dated rate capture instead of a general one
suggestions.problem: No booking engine returns a price to a static site.
suggestions.options: A) a scheduled job against the one official JSON price endpoint, storing only the itemised total · B) a monthly manual capture of a single date range into rates.json · C) keep rates blank and link the engine
suggestions.trade_off: A is the only automatic option but depends on an endpoint the property can change without notice; B is honest and slow.
suggestions.needs_decision: Pick A or B; C is the current state.
suggestions.recommendation: B until A is proven stable

suggestions.title: Ask the poker room for a written entry-rule schedule
suggestions.problem: No sheet prints an entry limit, so 'single entry' cannot be published.
suggestions.options: A) email the poker room and paste the reply into the site with its date · B) keep the three-state label · C) treat silence as single entry
suggestions.trade_off: C is the only option that is not honest.
suggestions.needs_decision: Send the email (A) or keep the current label (B).

suggestions.title: Score hotels on published facts only, and show the blanks
suggestions.problem: Quality is often scored with star ratings that no official page publishes here.
suggestions.options: A) score on published fee, tax, walk time and cancellation only · B) add a third-party star rating, clearly labelled · C) no score
suggestions.trade_off: B introduces a third-party judgement; A measures what is verifiable.
suggestions.needs_decision: Whether a third-party quality signal is acceptable on an official-source site.

suggestions.title: Make the change monitor write a real status per URL
suggestions.problem: The existing monitor files are placeholders after a day of scheduled runs.
suggestions.options: A) per-URL status with HTTP code, hash and tracked values, failing loudly · B) hash only · C) none
suggestions.trade_off: A costs one page and answers 'has anything moved since I last looked'.
suggestions.effort: done in this session for /audit/ sources

suggestions.title: Show the ratio as a range, not a point
suggestions.problem: Guarantee / entry fee is printed to two decimals, which implies precision that a floor does not have.
suggestions.options: A) print the ratio plus 'guarantee is a floor' inline · B) round to a whole number · C) drop the ratio
suggestions.trade_off: A keeps the signal and removes the false precision.

suggestions.title: Publish the day plan as a decision tree, not a timetable
suggestions.problem: A timetable implies the player will be free at 5 PM; the first event usually will not be over.
suggestions.options: A) each day: primary + 'if you bust before HH:MM, enter X' · B) fixed timetable · C) list only
suggestions.trade_off: A matches how a tournament day actually works.

suggestions.title: Add a 'what would change my mind' line to every flag
suggestions.problem: A flag that only says 'unverified' does not tell a reader how much it matters.
suggestions.options: A) each flag names the decision it blocks · B) severity only · C) neither
suggestions.trade_off: A is what makes the flag list usable.

suggestions.title: Keep the COORDINATION.md board as the source of truth for ownership
suggestions.problem: Three sessions regenerated the same root files and produced four dashboards.
suggestions.options: A) hard file ownership enforced by CI · B) advisory board only (current) · C) one generator for everything
suggestions.trade_off: A prevents the four-dashboard problem; C is the long-run answer.
